extracted.name: Linguine with Broccoli and Red Peppers
extracted.description: Linguine with broccoli and red peppers get sautéed in olive oil and garlic, then topped with Parmesan cheese for a quick, delicious meal or side dish.
ingredient_lines: 3 cloves garlic, minced, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes; drain.
Steam broccoli with 2 tablespoons water in the microwave for 6 to 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil and butter in a 10-inch skillet over low heat. Stir in garlic (more or less to suit your tastes), then red pepper slices; sauté gently.
Drain broccoli and add to skillet. Sprinkle lightly with garlic salt and sauté broccoli with peppers until soft.
Toss vegetable mixture with hot pasta. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
